AutoDock Vina 1.2.7, Apache-2.0. Upstream commit: 8eb40404f4f45608acb3b01427587ac049f27c1f (https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina).
Instrumentation adapted from the author's Molcy implementation: per-replica counts, replica 0 CSV and sampled retained states. Modified files: monte_carlo.cpp/h, parallel_mc.cpp, main.cpp. Snapshot capture uses a model COPY, without modifying the live model or drawing random numbers. Native energies are internal search objectives, not the final reported affinities. Coordinates in snapshots have PDBQT precision.
Build fix (2026-10-10), utils.cpp: get_file_contents() zeroes the part of the buffer that a text-mode read leaves unfilled. With CRLF ligand files of 4096 bytes or more, the MinGW runtime left stale bytes there and the parser rejected the ligand ("Unknown or inappropriate tag"); the reference vina.exe leaves zeros, which the parser ignores. Same parse as the reference; no change for files that already parsed.
